name: voice-mcp
description: Spoken end-of-turn summaries, question alerts, and a fire-and-forget speak tool for coding agents, with a shared speech queue, mute and stop controls, guardrails, and built-in macOS, Windows, and Linux voices.

interface.shortDescription: Hear when your agent finishes or needs you.
interface.longDescription: Speaks a short summary when a turn ends, reads questions aloud before the question prompt opens, and adds a fire-and-forget speak tool. One shared queue keeps several agents from talking over each other, with mute, stop, and anti-spam guardrails. Works with the built-in macOS, Windows, and Linux voices; Kokoro, Piper, or your own TTS command are optional.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use voice-mcp to say a short test sentence aloud.
